mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.title AS title, d.type AS type, kb.name AS kbName, MAX(bh.browse_time) AS lastViewTime FROM browse_history bh LEFT JOIN document d ON bh.doc_id = d.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_base kb ON d.kb_id = kb.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY d.id, d.title, d.type, kb.name ORDER BY lastViewTime DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, COUNT(d.id) AS docCount FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN document d ON kb.id = d.kb_id WHERE kb.creator_id = #{userId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY kb.id, kb.name, kb.description

SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, u.name AS creatorName FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN user u ON kb.creator_id = u.id WHERE kb.is_public = 1 AND kb.deleted = 0 ORDER BY kb.created_at DESC LIMIT 10
